A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same MaSS13K research work, with complete main text, figures, tables, equations and supplementary Sections A–D. Pages 2–17 render identically; first-page differences concern authorship credit and the version stamp.

before.justification: Section 5 and supplementary Section C report original segmentation benchmarks, component ablations, backbone comparisons and novel-category experiments.

after.justification: The original benchmark, ablation and novel-category results remain in Section 5 and supplementary Section C, including Tables 2–8.

M1.justification: Sections 4.1–4.3 retain the same MaSSFormer architecture, CST/RFB/LSE/EGF modules, losses and pseudo-label reweighting procedure.

E1.justification: The seven-category MaSS13K benchmark, additional Car and Bicycle segmentation experiments, and bokeh application examples are unchanged.

E2.justification: The 14 baselines in Table 2, Mask2Former comparisons in Table 5, and pseudo-label comparisons in Tables 3 and 8 retain identical comparator membership.

E3.justification: Both versions retain the 11,348/500/1,500 training/validation/test split, crop settings, model configurations, training budgets and mIoU/BIoU/BF1 evaluation procedures.

E4.justification: Component and label-reweighting ablations, backbone comparisons, per-category analyses and qualitative case studies in Section 5 and supplementary Section C are unchanged.

E5.justification: Table 1 retains identical descriptive mean and standard-deviation reporting. Neither version reports experimental run counts, seeds, confidence intervals or significance tests.

E6.justification: All numerical results and qualitative examples are unchanged, including appendix results. For example, Table 2 reports MaSSFormer test mIoU of 88.21 and BIoU of 48.39 in both versions.

T1.justification: The mathematical formulations, including the mask-complexity definition and Equations 1–9 for network operations, losses and evaluation metrics, are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same contributions: MaSS13K, MaSSFormer, novel-category segmentation transfer and benchmarking against 14 methods.

C2.justification: Interpretations of boundary accuracy, pseudo-label errors and category-specific performance are unchanged. Supplementary Section D retains the same dataset-coverage and computational-cost limitations.

D1.justification: Training, augmentation, optimizer, evaluation and pseudo-label-generation details in Section 5 and supplementary Sections B–C are identical. Dataset and code access information is unchanged.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion, research positioning and all 57 references are unchanged.

P1.justification: v2 adds equal-contribution markers for Chenxi Xie and Minghan Li and an explanatory first-page footnote. The scientific prose and section structure are unchanged.

P2.justification: First-page author spacing and footnote wrapping change, and the arXiv version/date stamp is updated. All figures, tables and the layout of pages 2–17 are unchanged.

improvement.justification: v2 clarifies equal-contribution credit and updates first-page formatting and version identification. The scientific content, evidence, explanations, reproducibility information and limitations are identical, so these limited edits do not meaningfully change overall paper quality.
